mines.status: Development (Updated PFS completed 1 Jul 2025; Fast-Track consent decision due 16 Dec 2026)
mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned flagship gold development in Central Otago, New Zealand, centred on the Rise and Shine (RAS) deposit within the Rise and Shine Shear Zone. Updated PFS (1 Jul 2025, incorporating March 2025 MRE): 1.2 Mtpa plant producing 1.25 Moz over 13.8 years (avg ~90 kozpa, peak 120 kozpa), targeting the redefined high-grade (HG1) domain; staged underground development from ~year seven. Conventional CIL plant with ~92.4% average recovery. Permitting: 30-year Mining Permit held; assessment under NZ Fast-Track Approvals Act - hearings June 2026, statutory decision date 16 Dec 2026 (~NZ$17.7M invested in process costs); development activities targeted early 2027. Land: OIO approval to acquire 3,680 ha freehold at Bendigo and Ardgour Stations incl. royalty buybacks. Drilling July 2026: mineralisation extended 900 m beyond current underground mine design. Rise and Shine Mining Permit under evaluation (100%); Ardgour Prospecting Permit (100%); Snoul, Cambodia (34%). [production_notes: No production (developer). FID pending Fast-Track consent decision (16 Dec 2026).] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: Updated PFS economics at A$4,950/oz gold: after-tax NPV6.5 A$1.5B, IRR 65%, total cash cost A$1,741/oz, AISC A$1,842/oz (AUD, flagged); pre-production capex A$277M incl. 10% contingency; LOM sustaining capex A$53M; payback ~1.7 years. (Original Nov 2024 PFS at A$4,000/oz: 1.5 Mtpa CIL, ~125 kozpa avg over 9.2 yrs of reserves, AISC A$1,416/oz, capex A$340M drawdown, after-tax NPV8 A$1.06B, IRR 68%.)]
